name: Learning Commons Evaluators
summary: Model-based evaluators, with their prompts, rubrics and validation data, that rate educational text for complexity, the quality of feedback on student writing, math standards alignment and critical thinking.
grades: not stated for the set (its text complexity data covers grades 3-4)

license.note: Code MIT; prompts and settings CC BY 4.0; the annotated CLEAR and PERSUADE 2.0 corpora CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).

access_note: Running an evaluator calls a model provider on your own key; math standards alignment also needs a Learning Commons API key. The SDKs are in early access.

fits.how: Its prompts and rubrics, Withholding Answers and Tone Appropriateness among them, could rate replies in agent tests, checked against people's ratings before their scores are shown.
